'''Harlas''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was stationed on the Sith [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], where he served the Empire as a vendor, working outside the ruins near the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]]. He sold a series of special items in return for [[commendation]]s earned on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Harlas had dark colored skin, a bald head, and brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. Whilst at his stall, he wore a gray Imperial uniform.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Harlas first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. In the game he acted as a speciality items vendor on Korriban, the starting world for players of the [[Sith Warrior]] and [[Sith Inquisitor]] classes.<ref name="SWTOR" />

Harlas was removed from the game in update 6.2 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]''.<ref name="Patch notes 6.2">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/1292020/game-update-6.2|text=Game Update 6.2}}</ref> He was later brought back to the game in update 7.1 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]''.<ref name="Patch notes 7.1">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/08022022/game-update-7.1-digging-deeper|text=Game Update 7.1: Digging Deeper Patch Notes}}</ref>
